Complaint filed against IPS officer for religious greeting

A complaint has been filed against Indian Police Service (IPS) officer Bushra Bano for allegedly refusing to recite 'Vande Mataram' and instead using the greeting 'Assalamualaikum'. The complaint was lodged by an individual who reportedly objected to the officer's religious salutation during an event. The specific details of the event and the exact nature of the objection are part of the complaint. The coverage does not specify the current status of any investigation or action taken.
